correctness.rationale: Directly checked all 729 triples of a nine-symbol alphabet, including 666 feasible local IDF patterns; each satisfies a nonnegative integer reduced-cost inequality with explicit potential. The 13-state trimmed zero-cost graph was checked transition-by-transition and decomposed bijectively into two starts and alternating 1/2/5 excursions, proving universal minimum n and generating function. All vertex labelings for n=2..6 were independently enumerated; exact transfer dynamic programming corroborated n=2..27. These numerical finite-order checks do not replace the complete local proof.

originality.rationale: The only retrieved exact ladder theorem determines the minimum weight rather than the number of minimizers. Full-text arXiv:2610.00108v1 enumerates paths, trees and cycles, not ladders. Specific searches for the three-tile recurrence, Roman {2} terminology, rational generating function and coefficient sequences found no covering result, including in the two own claim ledgers. Source access risk for the 2018 thesis is explicitly retained; no unpublished-world uniqueness is asserted. The special case L_2=C_4 is already covered by Shao and Zhao cycle tables; the claimed new content is the infinite ladder family and its complete tile bijection.
